items.description: Air conditioning unit - living room (higher-output replacement, larger cooling capacity than the damaged one)
items.rationale: Policy 7.1.9 and 7.1.10: Only a like-for-like replacement of the damaged 3.5 kW unit is indemnified; the upgrade to a 7.1 kW model is an improvement and not covered. Reference Case 38 sets t for a like-for-like living-room AC unit at 1352–1445 EUR gross. The excess for the higher output is excluded.
Policy 7.1.9(c): Labour for installing a like-for-like replacement is covered. Reference Case 38 sets t for installation at 468–488 EUR gross for a living-room AC unit.

items.description: Decorative floor console (chosen for room appearance, not required by the new unit)
items.rationale: Policy 7.1.10 and 3.5(d): Not indemnified, as it is an improvement for appearance only and not required for the function or installation of the replacement unit.
Policy 7.1.9(e): Ordinary carriage of the replacement unit is covered. Reference Case 38 sets t for freight shipping at 40–43 EUR gross.
Policy 7.1.12: Surcharges for expedited/timed delivery are not indemnified unless agreed in advance or necessary to avert further loss, which is not indicated here.
Policy 7.1.8(b): General administrative or processing charges are not indemnified, regardless of how they are described.
